mapper.select: select d.name, sum(all_sales.sale_num) as sales from dish d INNER JOIN ( -- 1、获取单品销量 select od.dish_id, od.dish_copies as sale_num from order_detail od INNER JOIN orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} and od.dish_id is not null and o.order_time between #{begin} and #{end} UNION ALL -- 2、套餐拆解销量：套餐内菜品份数（dish_copies 已是计算后的值） select sd.dish_id, od.dish_copies as sale_num from order_detail od INNER JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN setmeal_dish sd ON od.setmeal_id = sd.setmeal_id where o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} and od.setmeal_id is not null and o.order_time between #{begin} and #{end}) all_sales on d.id = all_sales.dish_id group by d.id, d.name order by sales desc limit 10;

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (SELECT #{begin} AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE dt <= #{end}) SELECT ds.dt AS date, IFNULL(COUNT(u.id), 0) AS dailyNew, IFNULL(SUM(COUNT(u.id)) OVER (ORDER BY ds.dt), 0) AS totalUsers FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN user u ON DATE(u.create_time) = ds.dt GROUP BY ds.dt;

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (SELECT #{begin} AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE dt <= #{end}) SELECT ds.dt AS date, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS dailyTurnover FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN orders o ON DATE(o.order_time) = ds.dt AND o.status = 5 GROUP BY ds.dt;

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (SELECT #{begin} AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE dt <= #{end}) SELECT ds.dt AS date, IFNULL(COUNT(o.id), 0) AS totalCnt, IFNULL(SUM(o.status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}), 0) AS validCnt FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN orders o ON DATE(o.order_time) = ds.dt GROUP BY ds.dt;
